text:
morgan: noticed a small but steady spike of 503s for short embeddings (tokens <32) in eu-west1 starting ~02:10 UTC. p99 errors up ~3%. Looks tied to yesterday's quant build. I'm preparing a hotfix that reverts the quant kernel to the known-good v2.3.2. Need quick approvals to push during the maintenance window.

liam: are customers blocked or degraded?

morgan: partial degradation for a subset of calls; ~3% of eu-west1 traffic. A couple of support reports; not universal. No DB or schema changes.

sara: will this require any cache reset?

morgan: KV prefixes may be incompatible briefly; planning a prefix-cache drain/warm after deploy. No data migration.

morgan: deploy request posted: /deploy request --service embeddings-eu --image redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix --strategy canary=5%:3m (option to skip canary if rapid consensus) --reason "short-embed 503 regression"

deploy-bot: Deploy request 6371122334 created. Approvals needed: eng-leads (liam,sara) + ops-oncall (dave-ops). Preflight: integration-tests PASS, smoke: WARNING (503 observed).

dave-ops: I'm oncall, can approve ops. I'd prefer a 5% canary for 3m then evaluate. I'll watch metrics and traces.

liam: approve for eng if dave monitors. /approve 6371122334

sara: approve for docs/QA. I'll draft a short note for support. /approve 6371122334

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: liam, sara, dave-ops. Starting canary 5% for embeddings-eu -> redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix. Canary window 180s. Logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/6371122334

morgan: running drain then kubectl set image: `kubectl set image deploy/embeddings-eu embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix -n prod-eu`

deploy-bot: Canary in progress. Initial metrics: errors dropping to 0 in new pods, latency stable.

dave-ops: canary looks green. ramp to 25% for 4m then full if stable.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% started. Window 240s.

deploy-bot: 25% complete, metrics healthy (errors <0.1%, p95 +3ms). Rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. Healthchecks PASS, e2e-smoke PASS.

morgan: drained prefix cache and warmed. No regressions in 10m post-deploy.

liam: good work. please add release note: "Embeddings: hotfix revert to v2.3.2 to address 503s on short embeddings in eu-west1; performed canary ramp and prefix cache drain."

sara: filing support blurb now.

morgan: will follow up with RCA on quant kernel and next steps. closing thread once notes posted. :white_check_mark:
